stdout:
Build kit for "Citation"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        ai-chat
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Transcript of alternating turns carrying mixed rich content inline (markdown, code blocks, collapsible tool-call output) beside a resizable artifact panel that holds generated output while the stream keeps scrolling.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template ai-chat --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: ai-chat (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks. Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        CitationShowcase
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: All citation variants at a glance: label chips and numbered badges, with and without icons and links.

name:        CitationSourceList
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A list of citation sources with icons, as you might show at the end of an AI-generated response or article footer.

name:        CitationInlineText
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Citations embedded within a paragraph of text, showing how they flow inline with surrounding content.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        Citation
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Citations display inline references to external sources.

name:        Blockquote
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A quotation block with a rule on its inline-start edge and secondary text color.

frame:      AppShell, TopNav, SideNav, Layout
foundation: VStack, HStack, Grid, StackItem, Card, Section, Text, Heading, Button, Icon, Badge, Divider
